versions.changelog:
- Initial release integrating ECB Data Portal statistics via Pontx.
- Supports discovery, bounded dataflows, DSD/codelist inspection, frequency-aware periods, and incremental retrieval.
- Enables previewing exact requests and choosing representation (processing, tabular, SDMX) before data download.
- Guides users to use live contract checks, partition large queries, and handle updates/revisions effectively.
- Emphasizes best practices for reliable ingestion, datapoint interpretation, and proper error handling.
